caption: The drawing depicts an entrance to a building, featuring a set of six beige stone steps leading up to a double door that is white and paneled. Flanking the steps are two green, decorative wrought iron railings, each supported by sturdy posts, and further decorated by two tall, narrow potted bushes placed on either side at the base of the iron posts. Above the doorway is an ornate, green iron canopy with intricate scrollwork, over which a mass of flowering vines with orange, yellow, and red blossoms is draped. On each side of the entrance, light green window shutters frame large windows; the surrounding wall is composed of light tan brick. The composition includes faded outlines of additional architectural elements and sidewalk in the foreground. The artwork utilizes light washes of watercolor for a soft, delicate effect, with the green, tan, and floral hues as dominant colors.
title: Ornamental Iron
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
